# agent module responsibility map

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-module-maps.mjs; DO NOT EDIT. -->

This file is derived only from `@responsibility` declarations in each source file header.

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `config-v4.ts` | Normalizes the v3/v4 project agent route profile into one typed shape. |
| `effort.ts` | Maps review gates to the required rig isolation distance in one effort table. |
| `final-review.ts` | Selects the final goal reviewer through the shared ranked peer-review primitive. |
| `isolation.ts` | Computes rig isolation tiers from resolved models, never agent names. |
| `model-config.ts` | Resolves configured agent models and fails loud when a required model is missing. |
| `pairing.ts` | Selects cross-agent pairing candidates from a qualified heterogeneous pool. |
| `peer-review.ts` | Decides peer-review verdicts from mode, candidates and reviewer selection. |
| `registry.ts` | Owns agent identity, availability and slot-config decision logic. |
| `role-cast-ranker.ts` | Ranks role candidates by capability against the cast role requirements. |
| `roster-gate.ts` | Guards the expected agent roster and forbidden position tokens. |
| `router.ts` | Routes backlog stories to agents by complexity tier with in-tier nudges. |
| `scope-config.ts` | Normalizes the roll-agents/v1 agent scope schema. |
| `scope-migration.ts` | Plans the migration from legacy agent config to roll-agents/v1. |
| `scope-resolver.ts` | Resolves recursive agent scope and role bindings. |
| `session-reuse.ts` | Resolves the warm-context session-reuse adapter for a routed agent. |
| `specs.ts` | Declares the agent spec vocabulary: normalizer kinds, usage extractors, roster and scaffold seeds. |
